title: JSG: Improved Textures
description: Makes JSG textures feel more vanilla.
body:
![Title1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd43e067b5c54aed0ceb774cfafc3b3d0ba89de9.png)
### **Resource pack that changes some textures of JSG to fit into modern minecraft.**
If you play modern minecraft you might feel like default JSG textures dont really fit in. This pack changes it and makes a lot of textures (except for TESR one) feel more _minecrafty_. This pack changes approximately 150 textures. It changes such textures as items, blocks, GUIs, inventory-models and armor.
